messages:
ryan: Pager alert -> APAC streaming degradations, 17:05 UTC. High genqueue latency, intermittent 5xx on streaming endpoints, queue length rising fast. Paging oncall.

incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-20260329-APAC-STREAM  Bridge: #incident-bridge-1767050123  Severity: P1 (investigating)

oncall-jen: ack. Jumping in. Looking at genqueue: pod pool worker-a3 repeatedly hitting OOMKilled, CPU near 100%, backlog spiked. Autoscaler didn't spin up additional workers in the last 4m.

ryan: can we divert new streaming sessions to apac-fastgen fallback pool? policy allows soft-fallback for partial degradation.

oncall-jen: applying routing rule now (temp-route-176705). Will monitor metrics.

oncall-jen: applied -> new sessions should go to apac-fastgen-2. Immediate drop in pending sessions observed (~30s). Latency for new streams improving.

natalie-support: prepping initial status note for customers and internal comms. Need a short customer-safe wording.

ryan: draft below (for status page / customer):

"Initial update (17:15 UTC): We are investigating an issue causing increased latency and occasional truncated streaming responses for customers in APAC. A subset of streaming requests may experience delays or partial outputs. We have rerouted new streaming sessions to a fallback model in APAC to reduce customer impact. Our engineers are investigating worker crashes and autoscaler behavior. We will provide updates every ~15 minutes.
Impact: Some APAC streaming requests may be slow or return incomplete responses (estimated up to ~20% of requests).
What we're doing: applied fallback routing; restarting affected worker(s); investigating autoscaler triggers."

lina-legal: minor wording request: change "truncated" -> "partial" and add "no evidence of data exposure at this time" if we mention exposure. Also avoid firm ETAs.

ryan: updated copy with legal tweak and shorter impact sentence, see below.

"Initial update (17:15 UTC): We are investigating an issue causing increased latency and occasional partial streaming responses for customers in APAC. Some streaming requests may be delayed or return incomplete outputs. We have rerouted new streaming sessions to a fallback model in APAC to reduce impact. There is no evidence of customer data exposure at this time. We will post updates approximately every 15 minutes.
Impact: A subset of streaming requests in APAC may be affected (estimated up to 20%).
Mitigation: fallback routing applied; restarting impacted workers; investigating autoscaler behavior."

product-sarah: I'll publish this to status page and ping #support + #sales with the link.

product-sarah: Statuspage update published: sp-1767050123-update1. Internal pings sent to #support and #sales with brief notes and link.

incident-bot: Statuspage update posted: sp-1767050123-update1

oncall-jen: update: restarted worker-a3 and bounced its node agent. Also adjusted autoscaler sensitivity (lowered scale-up threshold to react faster). Observed no further OOMs on that pod.

oncall-jen: genqueue backlog down to normal within ~7 minutes after restart. Latency trending back to baseline; monitoring for regressions.

natalie-support: posting update to support queue: customers with active incidents flagged, CSR template created for inbound tickets.

ryan: draft resolved notice to publish after 20m steady metrics:

"Resolved (17:50 UTC): The issue causing increased latency and partial streaming responses for some APAC customers has been resolved. The root cause was a worker process OOM combined with autoscaler thresholds that delayed capacity scaling. We restarted the affected worker and tuned the autoscaler; traffic was rerouted to a fallback model during mitigation. Service has returned to normal and there is no evidence of customer data exposure. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support with request IDs. A postmortem will be shared once available."

lina-legal: fine with wording, ok to publish once metrics stable.

product-sarah: will hold until 20m steady. publishing resolved then posting postmortem link in-thread.

oncall-jen: continuing to monitor; will escalate if anything reappears.

ryan: thanks everyone. good ops work. :thumbsup:
